g.text: UML sequence — Onboarding, pending checks and independent review (proposed)
Submit application + evidence refs + idempotency key
Validate required data, consent and offer version
Accepted with current state and status reference
Request distinct identity, screening and risk checks
Stable provider request IDs + minimized required data
No approval on timeout; application remains CHECKS_PENDING.
Review evidence / request information / propose decision
application check decision facts via outbox
Revalidate all gates; compare aggregate version
Create/link party once using application business key
Commit DECLINED or keep blocking state + reason refs
Actual state + permitted explanation / next action via API
Application approval is not account activation. No automatic merge by email/name.
